title: the network and thread globals are unavailable; fetch was never the only one
notes: specification/compatibility.mdx, 'Host Globals', names 'filesystem, and network' in the prohibition, and docs/DECISIONS.md (Locked) repeats it. `fetch` was the only network global the rule knew; `WebSocket` is a live global on Node 22, and all four grant the same authority an HttpClient capability exists to carry. 20-host-globals/host-globals-are-unavailable pins `process` and `document`; this pins the half of the sentence that had no case at all.
